title: Vinyl Made 2.5x CD Revenue, But Streaming Still Rules
hook: Vinyl earned about 2.5 times what CDs did.
closing: Physical music revived, but streaming still decides where most recording money goes.
question: Would you buy vinyl or stream?

segments.say: Vinyl earned about 2.5 times CD revenue, proving the older format can still beat the disc it once lost to.
Vinyl sold 41 million albums, enough to beat CDs by unit count as well as revenue.
Streaming still captures 84% of music revenue, so vinyl's comeback remains a physical-format victory inside a digital market.
